properties.entry: SELECT v.*, (l.to_id IS NOT NULL) AS liked, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM likes lm WHERE lm.from_id = v.id AND lm.to_id = :me) AS liked_me FROM member_view v LEFT JOIN likes l ON l.from_id = :me AND l.to_id = v.id WHERE NOT v.banned AND (CAST(:me AS TEXT) IS NULL OR ( v.id <> :me AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.from_id = :me AND b.to_id = v.id) OR (b.from_id = v.id AND b.to_id = :me)))) AND (CAST(:role AS TEXT) IS NULL OR v.role = :role) AND (CAST(:city AS TEXT) IS NULL OR v.city = :city) AND (CAST(:budget AS TEXT) IS NULL OR v.budget = :budget) AND (CAST(:frequency AS TEXT) IS NULL OR v.frequency = :frequency) AND (CAST(:maxAge AS INT) IS NULL OR v.age <= :maxAge) AND (CAST(:types AS TEXT) IS NULL OR v.relationship_types && STRING_TO_ARRAY(:types, ',')) AND (:verifiedOnly = false OR 'id' = ANY (v.verified)) AND (:onlineOnly = false OR v.online) ORDER BY v.last_active_at DESC LIMIT :limit

SELECT v.*, (l.to_id IS NOT NULL) AS liked, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM likes lm WHERE lm.from_id = v.id AND lm.to_id = :me) AS liked_me FROM member_view v LEFT JOIN likes l ON l.from_id = :me AND l.to_id = v.id WHERE v.id = :id
INSERT INTO members (id, role, nickname, birth_date, city, budget, frequency, relationship_types) VALUES (:id, :role, :nickname, :birthDate, :city, :budget, :frequency, STRING_TO_ARRAY(:types, ','))
UPDATE members SET last_active_at = NOW() WHERE id = :id
INSERT INTO accounts (member_id, email, password_hash) VALUES (:memberId, :email, :passwordHash)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE email = :email
SELECT a.member_id, a.password_hash, (m.banned_at IS NOT NULL) AS banned FROM accounts a JOIN members m ON m.id = a.member_id WHERE a.email = :email
INSERT INTO sessions (token_hash, member_id, expires_at) VALUES (:tokenHash, :memberId, NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days')
SELECT member_id FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = :tokenHash AND expires_at > NOW()
INSERT INTO likes (from_id, to_id) VALUES (:me, :target) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
DELETE FROM likes WHERE from_id = :me AND to_id = :target
INSERT INTO blocks (from_id, to_id) VALUES (:me, :target) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blocks WHERE (from_id = :a AND to_id = :b) OR (from_id = :b AND to_id = :a)
INSERT INTO reports (reporter_id, target_id, reason, detail) VALUES (:me, :target, :reason, :detail)
INSERT INTO conversations (member_low, member_high) VALUES (:low, :high) ON CONFLICT (member_low, member_high) DO NOTHING
SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE member_low = :low AND member_high = :high
INSERT INTO conversation_participants (conversation_id, member_id) VALUES (:conversationId, :memberId) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SELECT CASE WHEN c.member_low = :me THEN c.member_high ELSE c.member_low END FROM conversations c JOIN conversation_participants p ON p.conversation_id = c.id AND p.member_id = :me WHERE c.id = :conversationId

SELECT c.id, CASE WHEN c.member_low = :me THEN c.member_high ELSE c.member_low END AS other_id, m.body AS last_message, COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) AS last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages x WHERE x.conversation_id = c.id AND x.sender_id <> :me AND x.id > p.last_read_message_id) AS unread, (SELECT op.last_read_message_id FROM conversation_participants op WHERE op.conversation_id = c.id AND op.member_id <> :me) AS other_read_up_to FROM conversation_participants p JOIN conversations c ON c.id = p.conversation_id JOIN members om ON om.id = CASE WHEN c.member_low = :me THEN c.member_high ELSE c.member_low END LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.id = c.last_message_id WHERE p.member_id = :me AND om.banned_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.from_id = c.member_low AND b.to_id = c.member_high) OR (b.from_id = c.member_high AND b.to_id = c.member_low)) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) DESC
SELECT id, body, risk_flagged, created_at, (sender_id = :me) AS mine FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = :conversationId AND id > :after ORDER BY id
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, sender_id, body, risk_flagged) VALUES (:conversationId, :me, :body, :riskFlagged) RETURNING id, body, risk_flagged, created_at, true AS mine
UPDATE conversations SET last_message_id = :messageId, last_message_at = :createdAt WHERE id = :conversationId

UPDATE conversation_participants SET last_read_message_id = GREATEST(last_read_message_id, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = :conversationId)) WHERE conversation_id = :conversationId AND member_id = :me

UPDATE members SET nickname = :nickname, city = :city, job = :job, height_cm = :heightCm, education = :education, budget = :budget, frequency = :frequency, relationship_types = STRING_TO_ARRAY(:types, ','), tags = COALESCE(STRING_TO_ARRAY(:tags, ','), '{}'), intro = :intro, expectation = :expectation WHERE id = :me
UPDATE members SET photos = ARRAY_APPEND(photos, :url) WHERE id = :me AND CARDINALITY(photos) < :max
UPDATE members SET photos = ARRAY_REMOVE(photos, :url) WHERE id = :me AND :url = ANY (photos)
UPDATE members SET photos = ARRAY_PREPEND(:url, ARRAY_REMOVE(photos, :url)) WHERE id = :me AND :url = ANY (photos)
DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = :tokenHash
SELECT plan, ends_at FROM subscriptions WHERE member_id = :me AND ends_at > NOW() ORDER BY ends_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE member_id = :me AND plan = 'TRIAL'
INSERT INTO subscriptions (member_id, plan, starts_at, ends_at) VALUES (:me, :plan, :startsAt, :endsAt)
INSERT INTO payments (member_id, plan, amount, provider) VALUES (:me, :plan, :amount, :provider) RETURNING id
UPDATE payments SET status = 'PAID', provider_ref = :providerRef, paid_at = NOW() WHERE id = :id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE from_id = :me AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE from_id = :me AND to_id = :target
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = :conversationId AND sender_id <> :me

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes lk JOIN members m ON m.id = lk.from_id WHERE lk.to_id = :me AND m.banned_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.from_id = :me AND b.to_id = lk.from_id) OR (b.from_id = lk.from_id AND b.to_id = :me))

SELECT v.*, (l.to_id IS NOT NULL) AS liked, true AS liked_me FROM likes lk JOIN member_view v ON v.id = lk.from_id LEFT JOIN likes l ON l.from_id = :me AND l.to_id = v.id WHERE lk.to_id = :me AND NOT v.banned AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.from_id = :me AND b.to_id = v.id) OR (b.from_id = v.id AND b.to_id = :me)) ORDER BY lk.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
UPDATE members SET photo_visibility = :visibility WHERE id = :me

INSERT INTO phone_codes (member_id, phone, code_hash, attempts, sent_at, expires_at) VALUES (:me, :phone, :codeHash, 0, NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL '10 minutes') ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET phone = EXCLUDED.phone, code_hash = EXCLUDED.code_hash, attempts = 0, sent_at = EXCLUDED.sent_at, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM phone_codes WHERE member_id = :me AND sent_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 seconds'
SELECT phone, code_hash, attempts, (expires_at > NOW()) AS valid FROM phone_codes WHERE member_id = :me
UPDATE phone_codes SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE member_id = :me
DELETE FROM phone_codes WHERE member_id = :me
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE phone = :phone AND id <> :me
UPDATE members SET phone = :phone WHERE id = :me
SELECT phone FROM members WHERE id = :me
UPDATE members SET verified = ARRAY_APPEND(verified, :type) WHERE id = :me AND NOT (:type = ANY (verified))
UPDATE members SET income_label = :incomeLabel WHERE id = :me
INSERT INTO verification_requests (member_id, type, files) VALUES (:me, :type, STRING_TO_ARRAY(:files, ','))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_requests WHERE member_id = :me AND type = :type AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT DISTINCT ON (type) id, type, status, reject_reason, created_at, member_id, files FROM verification_requests WHERE member_id = :me ORDER BY type, created_at DESC
SELECT id, type, status, reject_reason, created_at, member_id, files FROM verification_requests WHERE status = :status ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100
SELECT id, type, status, reject_reason, created_at, member_id, files FROM verification_requests WHERE id = :id
UPDATE verification_requests SET status = :status, reject_reason = :reason, reviewed_by = :admin, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE id = :id AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE id = :me AND is_admin AND banned_at IS NULL
SELECT id, reporter_id, target_id, reason, detail, status, action, created_at FROM reports WHERE status = :status ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100
SELECT id, reporter_id, target_id, reason, detail, status, action, created_at FROM reports WHERE id = :id
UPDATE reports SET status = 'RESOLVED', action = :action, resolved_by = :admin, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE id = :id AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE reports SET status = 'RESOLVED', action = 'BAN', resolved_by = :admin, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE target_id = :target AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE members SET banned_at = NOW() WHERE id = :target AND banned_at IS NULL
DELETE FROM sessions WHERE member_id = :target
